records.claim: Taking loratadine is not expected to increase the chance of birth defects. One early study raised concern about a possible link between loratadine use in pregnancy and hypospadias (a birth defect where the opening of the penis is shifted toward the underside rather than the tip). However, after later studies did not find the same link, the researchers stated that the cases of hypospadias in their original study were most likely due to chance or other factors instead of exposure to loratadine.
